description: Source code for the PlatformService in Mattermost, managing core platform functionalities such as database access, caching, licensing, configuration, and plugin management.

classes.name: PlatformService
classes.description: Core service managing platform functionalities such as database, cache, licensing, configuration, plugins, and search engine integration.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new PlatformService instance with configuration, cache, search engine, licensing, and other core components.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the platform service, including status updates, hubs, and configuration/license change listeners.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the platform service, stopping hubs, status processors, and closing resources.

methods.name: ShutdownMetrics
methods.description: Stops the metrics server if running.

methods.name: ShutdownConfig
methods.description: Removes configuration listeners and closes the configuration store.

methods.name: SetTelemetryId
methods.description: Sets the telemetry ID and triggers propagation events.

methods.name: PostTelemetryIdHook
methods.description: Triggers events to propagate the telemetry ID.

methods.name: SetLogger
methods.description: Sets the logger instance for the platform service.

methods.name: SetSharedChannelService
methods.description: Sets the shared channel service interface.

methods.name: GetSharedChannelService
methods.description: Retrieves the shared channel service interface.

methods.name: SetPluginsEnvironment
methods.description: Sets the plugin environment hook runner.

methods.name: FileBackend
methods.description: Returns the file backend used for storing files.

methods.name: ExportFileBackend
methods.description: Returns the export file backend used for exporting files.

methods.name: DatabaseTypeAndSchemaVersion
methods.description: Returns the database type and current schema version.
